thread:
alex: Heads up — working on a Grafana page for a thermal "fingerprint" view per GPU slot. Want to capture transient temp spikes that correlate with short-lived fan ramps and PCIe power jumps. :thermometer:

maria: Nice. Are we targeting rack-level rollups or slot-level detail? For incident triage slot-level would be ideal but might be noisy.

kai: slot-level with an optional rollup. We can include a 'stability score' panel to suppress alerts for expected warmups after deploys.

alex: Agreed. Draft panels I'm thinking: 1) recent temp delta (5m P95 - 5m P5) per slot 2) fan RPM hysteresis overlay 3) power draw spikes (>x watts) 4) NIC error bursts correlated.

dennis: Can you drop example PromQL for the temp delta? I can paste into the dashboard.

alex: Sure — early idea, probably needs tuning:
```
# per-slot rolling delta (C) over 5m window
max_over_time(nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius{job="nvml"}[5m]) - min_over_time(nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius{job="nvml"}[5m])
```

maria: For hysteresis, maybe show fan RPM and add a derived column for rate-of-change so ops can see fast ramps.

kai: Fan rate-of-change example:
```
deriv(avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_fan_rpm[1m]))
```

alex: For power spikes I want a conditional panel highlighting when a slot's power jumps more than 150w within 30s. Rough query: 
```
increase(nvidia_gpu_power_draw_watts[30s]) > 150
```
That will be noisy; maybe require sustained for 2 samples.

maria: We should also include a small text panel with 'common causes' and triage steps: thermal throttling, driver stutter, bad NVLink, noisy neighbor kernels. Keep concise.

kai: Alert tuning idea — instead of firing on absolute temp, fire on the thermal fingerprint score combining delta, power delta and fan ramp. E.g. score = (temp_delta_norm * 0.5) + (power_spike_norm * 0.3) + (fan_deriv_norm * 0.2). Fire if score > 0.7.

dennis: Love that. Do we have a foldable Grafana transform for the weighted score? Might need a recording rule in Prometheus to compute the normalized metrics then a second rule for score.

alex: Yep, create two recording rules: one to normalize each metric to 0-1 based on historical 95p, and one to compute the weighted sum. I'll add examples to the repo.

maria: Quick question — any concerns with cardinality if we do per-slot and per-tenant rollups? We touch many labels.

kai: Keep tenant label out of high-card panels. For the per-slot views limit to GPU_ID and Rack, and use rollups for tenant-level cost dashboards. Also add a relabeling stage in scrape config to drop ephemeral labels.

alex: I pushed a WIP dashboard JSON to the grafana staging folder: https://grafana.internal/d/thermal-fingerprint/wip?orgId=1 — feel free to poke.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard updated in staging (id: 1123), snapshot created at https://grafana.internal/snapshot/abcd1234

dennis: I'll prototype the recording rules and ping when ready. Might also try a short-lived canary alert and route to a quieter channel first.

maria: Thanks — let's iterate. If we get the fingerprint alerts right we can reduce noisy temp alerts by ~40% in ops. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: Thanks all — plan: dennis will open a PR with recording rules, kai will add transforms & the stability score, maria will draft the triage text, I'll clean up panels and add links to playbooks. Will circle back in ~48h. :thumbsup:
